_note: BTAFF = ADR US de British American Tobacco (primary BATS.L London). Major tobacco + new categories transition.

kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires BAT 25.9 Mds£ en 2024. Recul due ITC US divestiture mais New Categories continue croissance.
kpis.description_en: BAT revenue £25.9B in 2024. Down due ITC US divestiture but New Categories keep growing.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu New Categories (Vuse vape, glo heated tobacco, Velo nicotine pouches) 3.4 Mds£ en 2024. Catégorie clé transition reduced risk.
kpis.description_en: New Categories revenue (Vuse vape, glo heated, Velo pouches) £3.4B in 2024. Key transition reduced-risk category.

kpis.description_fr: Volumes cigarettes 535 Mds bâtons en 2024. Déclin structurel global ~5%/an. Mix prix premium compense.
kpis.description_en: Combustibles volume 535B sticks in 2024. Structural decline ~5%/year. Premium price mix compensates.

kpis.description_fr: 12 millions de consommateurs Vuse fin 2024. Vuse = #1 mondial vape valeur, leader US, UK, France, Allemagne, Canada.
kpis.description_en: 12 million Vuse consumers end-2024. Vuse = #1 vape brand globally by value, leader US, UK, France, Germany, Canada.

kpis.description_fr: Marge opérationnelle ajustée 45.2% en 2024. Mix prix premium + scale + new categories profitability emergente.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted operating margin 45.2% in 2024. Premium price mix + scale + emerging new categories profitability.

kpis.description_fr: Free Cash Flow 8 Mds£ en 2024. Financement dividend yield ~9% + buybacks. Cash conversion >100% EPS.
kpis.description_en: Free Cash Flow £8B in 2024. Funds ~9% dividend yield + buybacks. Cash conversion >100% of EPS.
